title: Student Schematic Plan Review Record
description: One closed human review record bound to an already validated student schematic plan blocks document. The record never moves, redraws, ranks, or generates a schematic plan. A revise_schematic_plan outcome is valid human feedback but cannot produce a state handoff.

source_schematic_plan_blocks_sha256.description: The canonical JSON plus newline SHA-256 of the exact ARCH-107 schematic plan blocks document reviewed by the human.

outcome.description: A human decision only. The builder accepts continue_to_handoff for a state handoff and fails closed on revise_schematic_plan without creating output.

review_notes.description: At most three human-authored review notes carried verbatim. The machine never adds, edits, or interprets them.
